mechanism: Lactulose acidifies colonic pH and increases stool water content, which may reduce tobramycin absorption if given orally, though tobramycin is typically given parenterally and this interaction is clinically relevant only with oral tobramycin formulations.
action: Separate administration times by 2 hours if oral tobramycin is used; monitor renal function and tobramycin levels as lactulose may affect gastrointestinal absorption and alter pharmacokinetics.
